title: kate-core: return the suffix a completion would insert
summary: completion_suffix returns the suffix of the first matching word. An empty list returns None. The command still has its own copy of the rule. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in kate-core. Linux CI runs the test. It does not edit the command.

definitions.definition:
#[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]
pub fn completion_suffix(buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, at: kate_text::Offset) -> Option<String>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Call word_completions with limit 1. The suffix is the match without the prefix before the caret. An empty prefix returns None. A match equal to the prefix returns None. The function has cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)). Leave workspace.rs and keys.rs unchanged. The existing completion tests stay green. Leave theme.rs, paint.rs, layout.rs, and session.rs unchanged. PKT-0085, PKT-0088, and PKT-0089 own those files. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: completion::tests::completion_suffix_is_the_rest_of_the_word
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because completion_suffix does not exist. In alpha alphabet, the caret is Offset(4). The suffix is abet. An empty prefix at offset 0 returns None.
